Drug Target Proteins Having a reliable source for drug target proteins is crucial for drug discovery development. We have decades of experience producing KRAS, Polymerase Theta, PD-L1, and other drug target proteins for drug discovery efforts. All of our products are ISO 17025 certified and manufactured in San Diego, CA. Learn More Assay Development & Services Aurora Biolabs is a Structure Based Design, Inc. (SBD) subsidiary. Scientists at Aurora Biolabs and SBD have decades of experience developing assays and offering assaying services. We also offer compound screening, crystal structure and co-crystal structure determinations for drug discovery. Learn More Tools for Defeating SARS-CoV2 Aurora Biolabs is a US manufacturer of quality assay kits at a reasonable price to advance scientific research. Our 30-minute, 2-step SARS-CoV-2 Main Protease (Mpro) or 3CL Protease assay kit is among the list of hot-selling items on our online store. Order one for your SARS-CoV-2 research today! Learn More Inhibitor Compounds High quality small molecules are critical for reducing false positives in drug target screening and producing reliable data. Aurora Biolabs has supplied quality androgen receptor inhibitors for research use for some time. We are expanding our offerings to include more small molecules. Contact us for more detail. Biological Activity. Stability & Consistency About Us Aurora Biolabs is strategically located in the heart of San Diego’s premier biotech hub, Sorrento Valley. We specialize in the production of high-quality recombinant proteins, the development and manufacturing of precise, reliable assays, and the delivery of exceptional services that drive advancements in life science and drug discovery research. High purity, biological activity, stability, and consistency constitute the foundational standards of all our products. We are committed to becoming a trusted source of clean, dependable, and reproducible research data by consistently delivering materials of the highest quality. Backed by a team of experienced scientists and equipped with state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Aurora Biolabs is uniquely positioned to deliver scientifically rigorous, high-performance products that meet the highest standards of quality and client satisfaction. As a direct manufacturer, we maintain full control over our production processes—ensuring consistent quality while offering cost-effective, competitively priced solutions. All of our premium recombinant proteins and assay kits are proudly manufactured in the USA at our sole facility in Sorrento Valley, San Diego, California.
